collection_products_position_matches_mod.name: collection_products_position_matches_mode
collection_products_position_matches_mod.value: ("collection_products"."mode" = 'pinned') = ("collection_products"."position" is not null) and ("collection_products"."position" is null or "collection_products"."position" >= 0)

collections_name_en_valid.name: collections_name_en_valid
collections_name_en_valid.value: "collections"."name_en" is null or length(btrim("collections"."name_en")) between 1 and 200

collections_schedule_ordered.name: collections_schedule_ordered
collections_schedule_ordered.value: "collections"."starts_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" > "collections"."starts_at"

media_assets_dimensions_valid.name: media_assets_dimensions_valid
media_assets_dimensions_valid.value: "media_assets"."width" between 1 and 10000 and "media_assets"."height" between 1 and 10000 and "media_assets"."byte_size" > 0

media_assets_alt_ar_valid.name: media_assets_alt_ar_valid
media_assets_alt_ar_valid.value: "media_assets"."alt_ar" is null or length(btrim("media_assets"."alt_ar")) between 1 and 300

media_assets_alt_en_valid.name: media_assets_alt_en_valid
media_assets_alt_en_valid.value: "media_assets"."alt_en" is null or length(btrim("media_assets"."alt_en")) between 1 and 300

products_name_en_valid.name: products_name_en_valid
products_name_en_valid.value: "products"."name_en" is null or length(btrim("products"."name_en")) between 1 and 200

products_seo_title_ar_valid.name: products_seo_title_ar_valid
products_seo_title_ar_valid.value: "products"."seo_title_ar" is null or length(btrim("products"."seo_title_ar")) between 1 and 120

products_seo_title_en_valid.name: products_seo_title_en_valid
products_seo_title_en_valid.value: "products"."seo_title_en" is null or length(btrim("products"."seo_title_en")) between 1 and 120

products_families_distinct.name: products_families_distinct
products_families_distinct.value: "products"."secondary_family_id" is null or ("products"."primary_family_id" is not null and "products"."secondary_family_id" <> "products"."primary_family_id")

products_published_required_fields.name: products_published_required_fields
products_published_required_fields.value:
"products"."status" <> 'published' or (
        "products"."description_ar" is not null
        and "products"."category_id" is not null
        and "products"."primary_family_id" is not null
        and "products"."seo_title_ar" is not null
        and "products"."seo_description_ar" is not null
      )

brands_story_ar_valid.name: brands_story_ar_valid
brands_story_ar_valid.value: "brands"."story_ar" is null or length(btrim("brands"."story_ar")) between 1 and 5000

brands_story_en_valid.name: brands_story_en_valid
brands_story_en_valid.value: "brands"."story_en" is null or length(btrim("brands"."story_en")) between 1 and 5000
